decisions.why: every example is a fitting for a clinical trolley — POUDS wall bracket, Sharpsmart mounting bracket, height-adjustable laptop mount, Cutan foam sanitiser holder — i.e. clinical trolley/furniture components, consistent with this supplier's other trolley divisions already mapped to handling:furniture

the product examples are trolleys, not theatre capital plant — Narrow Procedure Trolley Under Worktop, Double Procedure Trolley Under Worktop, Narrow Paediatric Trolley; theatres:capital covers tables, lights and OR integration, which none of these are

examples are ward furniture items — Carebuddy Companion Bed, HYGI Portable Washbasin, Controlled Drug Cabinets, Self Administration Cabinets — cabinets, washbasin and a companion bed, all fixed/mobile clinical furniture
